purpose: Independent evaluator primary checks; not candidate repair or a substituted candidate source index

access_window.basis: Public primary retrieval occurred after observed native activation and before this source map’s first save. Window endpoints are bounded orchestration markers, not individual HTTP timestamps; per-request times are null.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor product overview
primary_sources.checked_fact: Kitchen-specific hosted scheduling, equipment, billing and onboarding are advertised. This establishes a relevant alternative, not verified product fit.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor signup plan selector
primary_sources.locator: Select Your Plan / All Plans Include, lines 34–101
primary_sources.checked_fact: Starter: $129/month, at most five clients. Annual: $206/month billed annually, unlimited clients; displayed fees 2% ACH or 4% card, and first-month-free promotion. Currency selector not changed.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor equipment reservation help
primary_sources.checked_fact: Equipment can occupy all or part of a room booking, with separate equipment time ranges. Documentation does not settle race safety or post-use signoff.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor food-business account
primary_sources.checked_fact: Documents account PIN, occupancy view, own reports, Community messaging, and business-profile fields. Does not establish exact cross-tenant visibility of the protected fields.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor onboarding checklist uses
primary_sources.checked_fact: Monthly cleaning/deep-cleaning checklist examples are documented; per-booking tenant-defined equipment signoff and complete export are not demonstrated.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor booking approval
primary_sources.locator: Submitted Bookings / Individual Calendars / Auto Approve
primary_sources.checked_fact: Submitted Bookings covers the next 30 days. Farther-ahead approvals use Individual Calendars. Per-client auto-approval is available; it does not resolve missing-signoff sanctions.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor reporting
primary_sources.checked_fact: Kitchen reports have client/date filtering and CSV download; All Bookings is current-year. These facts do not establish complete tenant cleaning-attestation archives.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor tenant digital sign-in/out
primary_sources.checked_fact: Attendance PIN and concern notes are documented, rather than an individual cleaning-completion attestation.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor admin digital sign-in/out
primary_sources.locator: Client PIN / manager attendance editing / invoices
primary_sources.checked_fact: PIN identifies a client account; managers can edit attendance; invoice hours are bookings rather than actual attendance. No individual-signoff guarantee follows.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor inactive accounts
primary_sources.checked_fact: Inactivation preserves account access, invoices, booking history and reports. Format, complete signoff export and retention duration remain unspecified.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor older account deletion help
primary_sources.checked_fact: Older guidance supports past invoice/report access, not complete annual export. The newer inactive-account article is separately checked.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor view-only permissions
primary_sources.checked_fact: Older view-only/client calendar guidance is a documented lead; it does not settle current precise private field visibility.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor tenant booking
primary_sources.checked_fact: Direct booking creation and equipment-range selection accompany calendar interaction. Their existence does not demonstrate accessibility.

primary_sources.title: The Food Corridor pricing FAQ
primary_sources.locator: Onboarding Flows / onboarding calls / transaction FAQ
primary_sources.checked_fact: Checklist add-on tiers, additional onboarding-call charge and payment-fee qualifications require a scoped quote. Included payment processing must not be double-counted.

primary_sources.title: Skedda buffer time
primary_sources.checked_fact: Per-space granularity; minimum 15 minutes; largest conflicting rule; future bookings only; system override. Equal before/after buffers may overlap each other, so interbooking separation differs from summing two buffers.

primary_sources.title: Skedda access and visibility
primary_sources.checked_fact: Private access requires login. With no content rules, regular users see time/date/space; system users see booking details. Most generous matching visibility rule applies.

primary_sources.title: Skedda custom fields
primary_sources.checked_fact: Fields are collected at booking creation and propagate to multiple outputs; required/admin-only/holder-visible configurations exist. These do not prove later equipment-use signoff.

primary_sources.title: Skedda exports
primary_sources.checked_fact: System-user List view exports CSV/XLSX; ordinary users lack equivalent filters; tablet view lacks export controls. A secure tenant-specific delivered extract remains possible.

primary_sources.title: Skedda booking/visit retention
primary_sources.locator: Data retention period setting / recurrence / export FAQ, lines 25–42
primary_sources.checked_fact: New accounts default to one-year retention with periodic automatic deletion. Plan changes do not reset the configured period; unsupported extended retention prevents new bookings. Longer retention and external periodic exports are conditional options.

primary_sources.title: Skedda booking requests and approvals
primary_sources.locator: Plan availability / pending requests / editing / custom admins
primary_sources.checked_fact: Premier Skedda or Advanced AllBooked required. Pending requests coexist without reserving space. Approved-booking editing and custom-admin exceptions apply; certain Outlook edits return a booking to pending. Multi-space Outlook-sync restrictions also exist.

primary_sources.title: Skedda system-user roles
primary_sources.checked_fact: System roles have broad powers and ordinary-policy exceptions. Administrator tests are necessary rather than assuming tenant rules govern all writers.

primary_sources.title: Skedda US/Canada pricing
primary_sources.checked_fact: Plus starts at $249/month billed annually with 35 spaces included; Premier starts at $349/month with 45. Pricing depends on space count, but $249 is not the displayed charge for each individual space.

primary_sources.title: Skedda corroborating vendor pricing description
primary_sources.checked_fact: Vendor corroborates Plus $249/month including 35 spaces and Premier $349/month including 45. No kitchen-specific quote is supplied.

primary_sources.title: Skedda approvals feature evolution
primary_sources.checked_fact: Feature evolution leads into the July support guide; it is not a verified booking-race defect or regression.

primary_sources.title: Spacebring pricing
primary_sources.locator: Business price / MAU / footnote, including line 578
primary_sources.checked_fact: Page displays $178/month, six-month term and 100 MAU; footnote specifies Euro billing. Local display and billing currency can coexist. Add-ons and actual kitchen quote remain conditional.

primary_sources.title: Spacebring shared-kitchen solution
primary_sources.checked_fact: Markets shared-kitchen room/equipment booking and preparation time per room. Does not establish independent cleanup duration, exact conflicts or tenant signoff/export.

primary_sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Recommendation
primary_sources.checked_fact: Keyboard/name-role/status criteria apply; 2.5.7 requires a single-pointer non-drag alternative with exceptions; 2.5.8 uses 24 CSS-pixel targets with exceptions. Neither proves wet-hand or complete screen-reader usability.

primary_sources.title: WAI dragging-movements explanation
primary_sources.checked_fact: Keyboard accessibility and non-drag pointer operation are separate checks; explanatory document is informative.

primary_sources.title: FDA Food Code 2026 publication
primary_sources.checked_fact: Food Code is a model for jurisdictional adoption, rather than automatically governing this unspecified kitchen.

primary_sources.title: FDA Food Code 2026 full text
primary_sources.checked_fact: Commissary discussion distinguishes direct-consumer food-establishment activity from supplying businesses/food-processing situations. Regulatory authority determines suitability; jurisdiction and sales channel are unknown.

primary_sources.title: PostgreSQL range types
primary_sources.checked_fact: tstzrange and default half-open constructors support exclusive-resource overlap constraints via GiST with resource equality and range overlap. Capacity sharing, row validity and multi-resource transaction semantics need additional modeling.

primary_sources.title: PostgreSQL row security
primary_sources.checked_fact: RLS requires enabling; enabled tables with no policies deny ordinary access. Owner/FORCE, superuser/BYPASSRLS and permissive-policy OR exceptions are material. This is not complete application privacy.

primary_sources.title: FullCalendar overlap option
primary_sources.checked_fact: Default true governs interactive drag/resize overlap; it is not persisted booking conflict protection.

primary_sources.title: FullCalendar issue 6393
primary_sources.checked_fact: Confirmed display/event-ordering defect; not a database double-booking defect.

primary_sources.title: FullCalendar fix
primary_sources.checked_fact: Code changes event placement/rendering and references issue 6393. Reviewer inspected source, without executing a regression.

primary_sources.title: FullCalendar release 5.9.0
primary_sources.checked_fact: Release records the event-rendering fix. Tag-page display independently confirms short commit; candidate full hash is not separately rehashed.

primary_sources.title: LibreBooking administration
primary_sources.locator: Schedule and Resource Configuration / Public Access
primary_sources.checked_fact: Exclusive by default; concurrency applies schedule-wide and disables Schedule View. Resource capacity means participants, not simultaneous reservations. Defaults include no duration limits, approval off, auto-permission and admin usage exemptions; public URLs become available to copy.

primary_sources.title: LibreBooking v7 release
primary_sources.checked_fact: v7.0.0 is the observed release endpoint; pinned code below uses its immutable commit.

primary_sources.title: LibreBooking mutable README
primary_sources.checked_fact: Announces Oct 13 high-impact release and pre-v7 admin takeover issue. Does not establish v7 affected by undisclosed issue. Lists PHP 8.2+, Apache 2.4+, MySQL 8/MariaDB 10.6+.
primary_sources.operation: web open and read-only raw README retrieval

primary_sources.title: LibreBooking pinned reservation list item
primary_sources.checked_fact: Buffer ID delegates to the wrapped reservation. Before/after list items subtract/add the interval respectively; this rendering code is not a database conflict oracle.

primary_sources.title: LibreBooking pinned regression source
primary_sources.checked_fact: Fixture passes 3600 and expects begin/end IDs derived from reservation 42. Reviewer did not run this test.

primary_sources.title: LibreBooking governing buffer argument
primary_sources.checked_fact: WithBufferTime documents an integer seconds argument and stores bufferSeconds. BufferedTimes subtracts/adds the same interval at start/end. This resolves fixture units, rather than proving any UI input unit.
primary_sources.operation: read-only urllib retrieval and text inspection

primary_sources.title: LibreBooking interval implementation
primary_sources.checked_fact: Integer parsing uses total seconds; formatted strings have a separate days/hours/minutes path. TestReservationItemView inherits the relevant method without override.
primary_sources.operation: read-only urllib retrieval and text inspection

source_limits: Mutable vendor pages establish current published behavior, not a deployed product acceptance result.
Immutable LibreBooking code and versioned PostgreSQL documentation were inspected, not executed.
GitHub release/issue evidence does not prove a live kitchen scheduler safe.
Official FDA model-code text supports applicability boundaries, not legal advice or a jurisdictional adoption finding.

operations.local: Read exact input map, assignments, rubric, original brief and plan, all mapped scientific stages and source indexes/maps. Recomputed every mapped byte length and SHA-256. Read supporting notes in only the authorized source roots.
operations.web: Independent official vendor, W3C, FDA, PostgreSQL, FullCalendar and LibreBooking primary searches/opens/finds. Read-only GitHub REST/raw-text retrievals for code provenance, units and ancestry.
operations.timestamp_detail: Per-operation exact request/response times unknown; no synthetic timestamps assigned.
